result_scope: Scoped helper review and synthetic negative validation only, against trusted user-owned quiescent CODEX_HOME. Ready for human/code review, not production acceptance.

SKILL_RECEIPT.plan: python scripts/office.py plan security --capability security-review --capability security-tools-reporting

operations.command: Independent inline Python tests using synthetic TemporaryDirectory fixtures
checks: plan/check on existing files preserves byte snapshots
hardlinked global AGENTS rejected; external file unchanged
symlink ancestor rejected; external tree unchanged
symlink registration lock rejected without mutation
symlink backup parent rejected by plan/apply without mutation

code_review: Fixed allowlist of 15 profiles from canonical contracts; no subprocess/network/dependency install
Config original byte prefix preserved; appended config parsed; existing registrations/profile customizations fail closed
Global managed block content digest checked; outside text preserved
Config overrides and explicit multi_agent false blocked
All path ancestors checked for links/reparse points and regular hardlinked files
Exclusive lock/backup creation; temporary file replace; concurrent byte snapshot rechecks
Backup before target replacement and best-effort reverse rollback; no host file contents in returned errors

assets: Existing Codex settings including potential secrets
threat_model.boundary: Trusted canonical bundle to explicitly selected user-owned host configuration; no privilege elevation
threat_model.controls: Opt-in apply; read-only plan/check; conflict preservation; sanitized diagnostics; link rejection; backups and rollback
assumptions: Trusted canonical source and user-owned destination
Quiescent filesystem; no hostile concurrent local process
Destination ACL already restricts access to the user

layer_status.Infra/DevOps: Scoped file/config mutation PASS; real host operation excluded
layer_status.Dependencias/Supply Chain: No third-party dependency introduced; source contracts trusted; no OSV package query applicable

limitations: No live CODEX_HOME apply, host reload or all-15 runtime invocation
Windows ACL protection is not established by chmod; user-owned private home precondition must be verified before live apply
Stdlib path checks do not eliminate hostile filesystem races; no claim of hardened privilege boundary
Best-effort rollback is not crash-safe multi-file atomicity and may leave directories/private backups
No repository-wide audit or independent Cloudflare second audit selected
No external scanners installed, no remote code/config sent, no merge/deploy authority
next_action: Governance reconcile current hashes/owner receipts and publish reviewed branch/PR within existing authorization. Live host apply requires separate routed scope and destination access/privacy checks.
